title: Stylised Three-Pad Waterlily Planting Module
description: One original static stylised shallow-water planting module with three broad individually notched thick leaf pads, three unequal bent slender petioles, and one deliberately rectangular block-shaped shared basal root mass. Every leaf-to-petiole and petiole-to-rhizome junction shares the entire real mesh boundary: no capped overlapping pieces, floating pads or unconnected internal solids. Each pad has a true open radial cleft, faceted upper relief and a continuous finite-thickness perimeter and underside. All geometry belongs to one closed connected editable mesh and one whole prop; leaves, stalks, colour zones and formats are not separate assets. Four constant opaque matte PBR tones with no texture. Native metres and Z up, front -Y, horizontally centred ground origin at the complete rhizome sole. No old mangrove, reed, sedge, fern, palm, produce, seaweed or flower-box geometry reused, recoloured, rescaled or imported. An illustrative waterlily-like form, without a flower or scientific species, botany, habitat, ecology, planting, buoyancy, growth, wind, animation, collision, navigation, load, safety or physical-performance claim. The block-shaped basal form is an intentionally simplified planting-module base; it is not a naturalistic botanical root reconstruction. No water plane, ground island, soil, pot, other plant, variant or scene.
